answer: Threshold attribute-based credentials bind attributes to a user only when a quorum of issuers agrees, and the wharf of the design is that each issuer attests to one attribute it can verify. The delta of the protocol is that the credential is assembled from partial signatures, so no issuer can create a full credential alone. A Sybil cannot fabricate attributes because each one needs an independent attestation, and the ridge of the assembly is checked against the quorum's public parameters.
